targets.queryText: SELECT CASE WHEN CAST(strftime('%s','now') AS INTEGER) - COALESCE((SELECT ts_epoch FROM pc_health WHERE host = 'kor' ORDER BY ts_epoch DESC LIMIT 1), 0) > 600 THEN -1 WHEN (SELECT up FROM pc_health WHERE host = 'kor' ORDER BY ts_epoch DESC LIMIT 1) = 0 THEN 0 WHEN COALESCE((SELECT cpu_temp_c FROM pc_health WHERE host = 'kor' ORDER BY ts_epoch DESC LIMIT 1), 0) >= 85 THEN 3 WHEN (SELECT mem_total_gb - mem_used_gb FROM pc_health WHERE host = 'kor' ORDER BY ts_epoch DESC LIMIT 1) < 2 OR COALESCE((SELECT swap_used_pct FROM pc_health WHERE host = 'kor' ORDER BY ts_epoch DESC LIMIT 1), 0) >= 95 THEN 2 ELSE 1 END AS "KOR", CASE WHEN CAST(strftime('%s','now') AS INTEGER) - COALESCE((SELECT ts_epoch FROM pc_health WHERE host = 'bfield' ORDER BY ts_epoch DESC LIMIT 1), 0) > 600 THEN -1 WHEN (SELECT up FROM pc_health WHERE host = 'bfield' ORDER BY ts_epoch DESC LIMIT 1) = 0 THEN 0 WHEN COALESCE((SELECT cpu_temp_c FROM pc_health WHERE host = 'bfield' ORDER BY ts_epoch DESC LIMIT 1), 0) >= 85 THEN 3 WHEN (SELECT mem_total_gb - mem_used_gb FROM pc_health WHERE host = 'bfield' ORDER BY ts_epoch DESC LIMIT 1) < 2 OR COALESCE((SELECT swap_used_pct FROM pc_health WHERE host = 'bfield' ORDER BY ts_epoch DESC LIMIT 1), 0) >= 95 THEN 2 ELSE 1 END AS "B-field", CASE WHEN CAST(strftime('%s','now') AS INTEGER) - COALESCE((SELECT ts_epoch FROM pc_health WHERE host = 'shifter' ORDER BY ts_epoch DESC LIMIT 1), 0) > 600 THEN -1 WHEN (SELECT up FROM pc_health WHERE host = 'shifter' ORDER BY ts_epoch DESC LIMIT 1) = 0 THEN 0 WHEN COALESCE((SELECT cpu_temp_c FROM pc_health WHERE host = 'shifter' ORDER BY ts_epoch DESC LIMIT 1), 0) >= 85 THEN 3 WHEN (SELECT mem_total_gb - mem_used_gb FROM pc_health WHERE host = 'shifter' ORDER BY ts_epoch DESC LIMIT 1) < 2 OR COALESCE((SELECT swap_used_pct FROM pc_health WHERE host = 'shifter' ORDER BY ts_epoch DESC LIMIT 1), 0) >= 95 THEN 2 ELSE 1 END AS "Shifter"

targets.queryText: SELECT (ts_epoch / MAX(($__to - $__from) / 600000, 1)) * MAX(($__to - $__from) / 600000, 1) AS time, AVG(CASE WHEN host = 'kor' THEN cpu_pct END) AS "KOR", AVG(CASE WHEN host = 'bfield' THEN cpu_pct END) AS "B-field", AVG(CASE WHEN host = 'shifter' THEN cpu_pct END) AS "Shifter" FROM pc_health WHERE ts_epoch >= $__from / 1000 AND ts_epoch < $__to / 1000 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
